## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for gameplay / protocol / validation logic
- [ ] `dotnet format`, build and tests pass locally
- [ ] Multiplayer impact considered (server authority, determinism, protocol version bump if wire format changed)
- [ ] Mobile performance impact considered (allocations, update cost, budgets in docs/PERFORMANCE.md)
- [ ] Security considered (untrusted input validated, no secrets committed)
- [ ] Documentation updated (README / docs/*)
- [ ] New assets have a licence entry in docs/ASSET_LICENSES.md
